title: An efficient algorithm for entropic optimal transport under martingale-type constraints

contributions.purpose: 求解带 (super-)martingale 结构约束的最优传输 (MOT) 问题，这类问题因每个源点上都有 O(n) 个等式/不等式约束而难以用标准 OT 方法高效处理
contributions.mechanism: 对 MOT 提出一种基于近似约束满足的 entropic regularization 公式，并引入 Sinkhorn 型算法与利用对偶目标 Hessian 稀疏性的 Sinkhorn-Newton-Sparse (SNS) 稀疏 Newton 迭代算法（含 warm initialization 与 geometric η scheduling）
contributions.evaluation: 三个数值实验（option pricing、随机 cost、diversity 约束下随机排序），n=800、η=1200，评价指标为与参考熵最优解的 l1 距离；SNS 在少数迭代内收敛到机器精度，远超 APDAGD 基线；随机实例重复 100 次均在 N2=5 步稀疏 Newton 内达机器精度
contributions.domain: 最优传输 / 数值优化（martingale optimal transport）
contributions.source_quote: For the MOT problem, we propose a novel entropic regularization approach based on approximate constraint satisfaction. ... We introduce a Sinkhorn-type algorithm and a Sinkhorn-Newton-Sparse algorithm for OT under martingale constraints and super-martingale constraints.

contributions.purpose: 为所提熵正则化 MOT 方法提供理论保证，说明熵最优解逼近原 LP 解的质量
contributions.mechanism: 沿用 Weed (2018) 的分析证明熵最优 MOT 解与 LP 解之间的距离随正则化参数指数收敛
contributions.evaluation: 定性理论结论：证明 entropically optimal MOT solution 与 LP solution 指数接近（无量化基准）
contributions.source_quote: Following the analysis in Weed (2018), we prove that the entropically optimal MOT solution is exponentially close to the LP solution.

contributions.purpose: 论证 SNS 算法在 martingale-type 约束下依然高效的前提（Hessian 可稀疏近似）
contributions.mechanism: 将 Tang et al. (2024a) 提出的 approximate Hessian sparsity 论证推广到 martingale-type 约束设置，并做复杂度分析（每迭代 O(n^2)，与 Sinkhorn 相同）
contributions.evaluation: 定性分析结论：只需保留 O(1/n) 比例的 Hessian 元素即可获得准确近似；每迭代复杂度 O(n^2)
contributions.domain: 数值优化 / 稀疏线性代数
contributions.source_quote: We show that the approximate Hessian sparsity in Tang et al. (2024a) extends to the martingale-type constraint setting.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This work is more similar to Tang et al. (2024a), which uses a variational framework derived directly from the entropic LP formulation. The main contribution of this work compared to Tang et al. (2024a) is that this work applies to a setting in which one has O(n) equality constraints. In contrast, Tang et al. (2024a) has an explicit assumption that only O(1) constraints are allowed for efficiency consideration.

we propose to consider a modified LP problem for MOT, first introduced in Guo & Obloj (2019), with the defining feature that it allows for the transport plan to have constraint violations under a threshold.
We show that the approximate Hessian sparsity in Tang et al. (2024a) extends to the martingale-type constraint setting.

notes: 方法型论文（reject）。核心卖点是把 Tang et al. (2024a) 的 Sinkhorn-Newton-Sparse 框架从 O(1) 约束推广到 O(n) 约束的 martingale 设置。实验只与 APDAGD 单一基线比较，全部为作者自造的合成/半合成问题，均报告正结果（收敛快于 APDAGD、达机器精度），未见负结果或平局。理论贡献沿用 Weed (2018) 的现成分析路径。
